summary: The Justice Institute of British Columbia's current eagle-shield logo (a supplied Illustrator file), and its earlier monogram — a triangle with B and C — from the supplied JIBC badge vector package also used for its patches (vendor/patcher library/supplied/jibc-fan-badge).

assets.label: Justice Institute of British Columbia — Eagle shield and name
assets.sourceLocator: The Institute’s current logo file (logo.svg, an Adobe Illustrator 26 export), supplied
assets.notes: A blue eagle rising in a white, blue-edged shield, beside “Justice Institute” and “BRITISH COLUMBIA”: the Institute’s current logo.
assets.fidelityNote: The supplied Illustrator file with only its lettering changed from white to black for a light ground (the shield, its white field and its blue #034EA2 unchanged). Which colour the Institute sets its lettering in on light grounds is not established here; the supplied, reversed file is the other version.

assets.label: Justice Institute of British Columbia — Eagle shield and name, reversed
assets.sourceLocator: The Institute’s current logo file (logo.svg, an Adobe Illustrator 26 export), supplied
assets.notes: The supplied file: the shield and its white field with “Justice Institute” and “BRITISH COLUMBIA” in white, for a dark ground.
assets.fidelityNote: The supplied file, unchanged: an Illustrator export with the shield in blue (#034EA2) and the lettering in white. When it was adopted is not established.

assets.label: Justice Institute of British Columbia — Monogram
assets.sourceLocator: The centre of the Institute’s fan-shield shoulder badge (patch S56-O46)
assets.notes: The Institute’s monogram: a triangle split by a gap, with B and C in its centre. It is the centre of the Institute’s fan-shield badge and, in gold, of its navy roundel (Patches, S56-O46 and S56-O36).
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: four authored paths — two angular parts and the B and C, with real counters — rebuilt after an image of the badge. The blue (#0141A2) is sampled from that image.
